replicaCount.description: Pods to run. Two or more roll one at a time. The portal keeps no state in the pod.

image.description: The portal image. A digest wins over a tag. With neither, the chart's appVersion is the tag.

digest.description: Such as sha256:... Pin by digest in production.

imagePullSecrets.description: Existing image pull Secrets, as a list of {name: ...}.

serviceAccount.description: The pod mounts no service account token whichever one it runs as.

portal.description: The portal's own settings, each the environment variable of the same name in cmd/portal.

userHeader.description: Required. The request header the sign-in proxy sets to the signed-in person, PORTAL_USER_HEADER. The portal trusts it without checking, so only the proxy may reach the Service. With oauth2-proxy in reverse-proxy mode it is X-Forwarded-Email.

orgName.description: Organisation name shown on Settings, PORTAL_ORG_NAME.

publicURL.description: The address runners reach the portal at, such as https://portal.example.org, PORTAL_PUBLIC_URL. Without it no machine can join or link.

trustedOrigins.description: Origins allowed to post when the proxy rewrites the host, PORTAL_TRUSTED_ORIGINS.

homeDir.description: Folder holding the checked-out team home, PORTAL_HOME_DIR. Mount it through extraVolumes. The chart does not fetch it.

runnerArgs.description: The flags the join command ends with, PORTAL_RUNNER_ARGS. A runner needs -box-image, -desk-image, -relay-image and -proxy-image.

databaseSchema.description: The Postgres schema that holds every table, migration and goose's version table, PORTAL_DATABASE_SCHEMA. The portal makes it when missing. Empty is the schema the database URL selects. Use it when other software shares the database.

secrets.description: The chart holds no secret value unless secrets.create is set. It reads these from one Secret, an existing one or the one it renders.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret in the release's namespace. Set this or create, not both.

create.description: Render the Secret, named <fullname>-secrets, from secrets.values, in place of existingSecret. A change to a value rolls the pods.

values.description: What secrets.create puts under the keys. All three are required with it.

keys.description: Which key of that Secret holds what.

databaseURL.description: A Postgres URL, PORTAL_DATABASE_URL. The chart ships no Postgres.

secretKey.description: Base64 of 32 random bytes, PORTAL_SECRET_KEY. It encrypts stored secret values: losing it loses them.

internalSecret.description: One value every replica shares, PORTAL_INTERNAL_SECRET, so a terminal can hop to the replica that holds a machine's link.

stop.description: The stop rule. A pod told to stop fails readiness, waits for traffic to move, then drains.

waitSeconds.description: preStop sleep while the Service stops sending traffic.

drainSeconds.description: The longest the portal may drain after SIGTERM. The spec's bound is 30.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Must be longer than stop.waitSeconds + stop.drainSeconds. The chart refuses to render otherwise.

service.description: Point the sign-in proxy's upstream here.

ingress.description: Off by default. It exposes only the machine paths, never the pages, because the portal trusts the user header.

paths.description: The paths sent to the portal. The defaults are the GitHub webhook, the runner join and link, and the routes the tasks' proxies call with their per-task tokens. None of them can sit behind a browser sign-in. People reach the portal through the sign-in proxy instead.

patterns.description: Paths with a wildcard segment, written as regular expressions and routed with pathType ImplementationSpecific. The default is the desk's publish route, /api/tasks/<id>/results. With any, the chart sets ingress-nginx's use-regex annotation, so another controller needs its own way to read them.

annotations.description: Event streams are long responses: turn response buffering off and raise read timeouts if the controller buffers by default.

hosts.description: One Ingress per entry, named <fullname>-<name>, in place of the single one. A field an entry sets, an empty list too, replaces the top-level field of the same name.

settings.description: A whole settings document, as the editor takes it, with real secret values inline. The portal saves it as version 1 at start, only when no settings exist. The chart renders it into a Secret, <fullname>-seed, and mounts it read-only. A change rolls the pods and does nothing once version 1 exists.
